name: Kurayami 2 ~Tozasareta Meikyuu~
source:
Hero and a heroines are trapped in closed space of the subway. What happens to them? There are five heroines each telling a unique story.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
男主角和女主角被困在地铁的封闭空间里。他们会怎样？有五位女主角，每个人都讲述着一个独特的故事。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
